components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields

      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits;
            any separators (spaces, parentheses, hyphens) are accepted and stripped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

        - city
        - telephone

## Summary

I changed telephone handling so numbers are stored and returned in E.164 form, with duplicate detection comparing those E.164 values.

**What I changed**

1. **New utility — `E164Telephone.java`** (`rest/function/owner/`): centralizes the conversion. It strips spaces/dashes/brackets, keeps a leading `+` and country code when present, otherwise assumes `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits, and requires 8–15 digits after the `+`. Returns `null` when no valid E.164 form exists. So `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678` and `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`.

2. **`NormalizeOwnerTelephone`** (the create pipeline's normalize step): now stores the E.164 string, throwing the existing checked `InvalidTelephoneException` (→ 400) when the number can't form valid E.164. This replaces the old "exactly 10 digits, store digits-only" behavior.

3. **`RejectDuplicateOwnerTelephone`**: now detects duplicates by comparing E.164 values instead of digits-only strings.

4. **`Owner` entity**: relaxed the bean-validation constraint on `telephone` from `@Digits(integer=10)` + `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` to `@Pattern("^\\+?[0-9]{8,15}$")`, so the persisted E.164 value validates (while still accepting the legacy 10-digit values that repository/controller tests save directly). Removed the now-unused `@Digits` import.

5. **`openapi.yml`**: updated the `telephone` field description and example to reflect the E.164 rule (the request DTO is regenerated from this at build time; it had no blocking pattern, only length limits which E.164 satisfies).

**Verification**
- The new acceptance tests pass: national → E.164 (`+61412345678`), explicit country code preserved (`+6421123456`), and unformattable `"12"` → 400.
- Full suite: 256 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors.

One scope note: the `PUT /api/owners/{ownerId}` pipeline does not run the normalize/duplicate steps (it copies the field verbatim, as it did before this change), so E.164 normalization applies on create. The spec and the new tests target the create endpoint, and I kept PUT's existing behavior to preserve the passing update tests.
